title: Add: band shows Waiting for your permission while only background agents run
context: Owner screenshot 2026-10-25: the band and Trust light read 'Waiting for your permission' while the session was only running background agents. Root cause: runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.tsx tool.check handler sets live waitingOn=permission for every tool check with decision ask and approver person, including checks from subagents (no agentId filter, unlike turn.start and turn.complete), and the flag clears only when a tool starts in the main thread or the main turn ends. Add to this change: track the asking agent, clear the flag when that agent moves on or finishes or the main turn starts, and never let a background agent's settled check hold the band on Waiting for your permission.
